entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hi, I need to make a return for an order I placed a couple of months ago.
Thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Charlie. I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Great, thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the Pro-Series Jersey. Just to be sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the item?
It's simply the wrong size. I thought it would fit, but the jersey is just too tight across the shoulders. I'd like to do an exchange for the next size up if possible.
I see. One moment while I check our return policy for you.

Okay, I've reviewed the order and our policy. It looks like you received this 82 days ago, and our standard return window is 90 days. So, you're well within the timeframe. I've just initiated the exchange for you.
Excellent, thank you for making that so easy.
Of course. You'll receive an email shortly with a pre-paid shipping label to send the original jersey back. Once we see that it's in transit, we'll ship out the larger size.
That sounds fair. Now, since I had to hold onto it for a bit and go through this process, is there any chance you could toss in a small discount code for my next purchase? Maybe 10%?

I'm glad I could process this exchange for you. While our system doesn't allow for discount codes on return-related transactions, I can assure you the new item will ship out with no additional cost for shipping. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, I suppose that's it. Worth a try. Thanks for your help, Charlie.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
